name: Guillaume Apollinaire
contribution: A Polish-French poet, playwright, short story writer, novelist and art critic of Polish, Swiss and Italian descent.

checks.lead: Guillaume Apollinaire ( ə-POL-in-AIR, French: [ɡijom apɔlinɛːʁ]; born Wilhelm Albert Włodzimierz Aleksander Apolinary Kostrowicki; 26 August 1880 – 9 November 1918) was a Polish-French poet, playwright, short story writer, novelist and art critic of Polish, Swiss and Italian descent.
